comparison.objective: Fit two bevelled steel coupons for a V-groove weld.
comparison.physical_skill: Part flipping, bevel identification, planar alignment, and millimetric gap setting.
comparison.success_condition: Both bevels face inward, 1.6–3.2 mm root gap at both ends, ends aligned within 5 mm, flat and still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests two-part weld fit-up geometry, not agitation and multi-object sorting.
